title: From Parchment to Pixels: The 1,600-Year Chronicle of Ethiopian Education

chapters.chapter_title: The Cradle of Ge'ez Literacy: Axum and Nebab Bet
chapters.summary: Exploration of the ancient stone inscriptions of King Ezana and the birth of indigenous reading schools.

chapters.chapter_title: Saint Yared & The Musical Triad of Axum
chapters.summary: Demonstration of the Ge'ez, Ezel, and Araray musical modes and traditional sistrum rhythmic accompaniment.

chapters.chapter_title: Sem-enna-Worq: The Intellectual Masters of Qene Bet
chapters.summary: Interviews with senior Liqawunt in Washera analyzing the dual meaning of classical Ge'ez poetry.

chapters.chapter_title: Menelik II to Addis Ababa University: Modern State Schooling
chapters.summary: Archival footage of the 1908 Menelik II School, Teferi Mekonnen School, and the 1950 founding of UCAA.

chapters.chapter_title: The Digital Frontier: 50+ Modern Universities & STEM Evolution
chapters.summary: Contemporary laboratories, satellite engineering at ETRSS-1, and artificial intelligence research at AAU.
